bio.text: Megan Dahle, a Republican, represents the 1st Senate District in the California State Senate.
Her Senate website says she was elected to the Senate in 2024 after serving in the California Assembly since 2019.

According to the same page, she is a family farmer and small-business owner who lives in rural Northern California and previously served on the Big Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees in Lassen County.
